name: synapse
description: Route Synapse tasks and capture durable Codex session memory.

interface.shortDescription: Route tasks and preserve durable session memory.
interface.longDescription: Synapse checks a project's inbox on the next owner prompt and routes queued messages into visible Codex tasks. It also captures concise Markdown session memory at regular turn checkpoints and after compaction.
defaultPrompt: Show me where Synapse stores session memory.
